title: Microsoft Purview: Data Security Posture Agent in DSPM
summary: The briefing passes: the deployment requirement, licensing, consumption meter, control paths and audit command are supported by Microsoft documentation. The checklist names several controls that are not represented in the controls table; this is a minor completeness issue.

claims.claim: A per-run SCU figure for this agent is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent SCU per run consumption rate; read get-started licensing, Purview billing models, Security Copilot inclusion and usage pages. Results describe complexity-dependent consumption, not an agent-specific per-run figure.

claims.claim: Deactivate agent is reached in the Microsoft Purview portal through Agents > Explore agents > View agent > ellipsis next to Edit agent > Deactivate agent.
claims.quote: select Agents. Select Explore agents. Select View agent for the agent you want to pause. ... select the ellipsis (three dots) next to the Edit agent button. Select Deactivate agent.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API, PowerShell cmdlet or CLI command for deactivating this agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent API PowerShell deploy deactivate remove SCU usage; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Posture Agent deploy deactivate remove; Security Copilot agents API deactivate deployment Purview. Read get-started and agents-manage; only portal deactivation documented.

claims.claim: Deactivation stops the agent without removing it.
claims.quote: Deactivating the agent stops it from functioning. It doesn't remove the agent.

claims.claim: Remove agent deletes the agent from Microsoft Purview.
claims.quote: Removing the agent deletes it from Microsoft Purview.

claims.claim: There can be only one instance of this agent in a tenant.
claims.quote: There can be only one instance of each agent in a tenant.

claims.claim: Agent deployment and management require the permissions identified by the get-started page.
claims.quote: Sign in to the Microsoft Purview portal with an account that has the required permissions.

claims.claim: The agent's Performance tab is reached through Microsoft Purview portal > Agents > Explore agents > View agent > Performance.
claims.quote: In the left hand navigation pane, select Agents. Select Explore agents. Select View agent for the agent you want to edit. This action opens the agent overview page. Select the Performance tab.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API, PowerShell cmdlet or CLI command for reading this agent's SCU use.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent API usage; Data Security Posture Agent API PowerShell deploy deactivate remove SCU usage. Read get-started Monitoring SCU usage and Security Copilot manage-usage; found Performance, usage dashboard and export, not an agent SCU-read call.

claims.quote: Monitoring SCU usage ... Select the Performance tab. Track your SCU consumption in the usage monitoring tool.

claims.quote: Security Copilot portal required role: Azure capacity owner or contributor who are also Security Copilot owners.

claims.quote: You must be assigned the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs roles in the Microsoft Purview portal to search the audit log. ... To access audit cmdlets, you must be assigned the Audit Logs or View-Only Audit Logs roles in the Exchange admin center.

claims.claim: The Data Security Posture Agent is a Microsoft Security Copilot agent in Microsoft Purview DSPM.
claims.quote: Microsoft Security Copilot agents are AI-powered processes that help you with specific role-based tasks. Microsoft Purview offers: ... Data Security Posture Management posture agent in preview

claims.claim: The agent discovers sensitive content using a user's natural-language intent.
claims.quote: The agent's primary role is to help you discover sensitive data across your data estate by using a simple natural language-based search. ... it uses large language models (LLMs) to understand user intent.

claims.claim: The agent assesses risk associated with the content it finds.
claims.quote: The experience includes a concise summary and an associated risk analysis generated by the LLM.

claims.claim: Microsoft describes the agent as quick intent-based search for pre-investigation checks.
claims.quote: This agent acts as a quick, intent-based search mechanism for sensitive data. It's designed for pre-investigation checks rather than formal cases

claims.claim: Formal cases still require other Purview solutions such as eDiscovery, audit and Data Security Investigations.
claims.quote: formal cases that still require other Microsoft Purview solutions, such as eDiscovery, audit, and Data Security Investigations.

claims.claim: Deployment offers an agent identity or the identity of the user deploying it.
claims.quote: Create and use agent identity (recommended): Create a separate Microsoft Entra agent identity for the agent. ... Assign and use my identity: Set up the agent by using the identity of the user or admin who sets up the agent.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Deploying with an agent identity requires the deploying account to have Role Management.
claims.quote: The account used to deploy the agent with an agent identity must have the Role Management role.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Microsoft recommends deploying with an agent identity.
claims.quote: We recommend that you deploy the agent using an agent identity.

claims.claim: With Assign and use my identity, activities are associated with the deploying user's identity.
claims.quote: Assign and use my identity: Set up the agent by using the identity of the user or admin who sets up the agent. Associate all activities with the user's identity.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The Purview agents overview says agents are not administrative unit aware.
claims.quote: Agents aren't administrative unit aware. But if the agent runs in the context of an administrative-unit restricted admin ... the agent only sees alerts from the policies that scoped to the admin unit.

claims.claim: The DSPM considerations page says restricted administrators viewing asset explorer see only their assigned administrative units' user data.
claims.quote: restricted administrators who view policies, reports, activity explorer or asset explorer see data for users in their assigned administrative units only.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: The documentation does not clearly reconcile administrative-unit scoping of asset explorer with agent searches.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent administrative units search scope. Read Purview agents overview and DSPM considerations; searched excerpts from DSPM application card and Purview administrative units. Found asset-explorer scoping and agent/alert caveats, but no reconciliation for agent searches.

claims.claim: Users can apply a sensitivity label to up to 10 discovered files at a time.
claims.quote: You can select up to 10 files at a time and apply the same label to all selected files.

claims.claim: The labelling prerequisites name Data Classification Content Viewer or Purview Content Analyst.
claims.quote: Users with the Data Classification Content Viewer or the Purview Content Analyst role can apply sensitivity labels.

claims.claim: In some cases, the agent scans at most 5 GB or 10K items from selected sources.
claims.quote: In some cases, the Agent downloads and scans max 5 GB or 10K items from the selected data sources.

claims.claim: The agent returns only the top 1,000 matched items.
claims.quote: The Agent only returns the top 1,000 matched items.

claims.claim: Only two prompts can run concurrently.
claims.quote: You can only run two prompts concurrently.

claims.claim: The DSPM considerations page instead specifies search support for up to 1 GB of content.
claims.quote: Search supports content up to 1 GB of data, but not metadata.

claims.claim: Microsoft does not reconcile the documented 1 GB and 5 GB or 10K-item limits.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent SCU per run consumption rate administrative units 1 GB 5 GB. Read get-started and DSPM considerations; DSPM application-card search excerpts repeat 1 GB per query. No passage explains the relationship to 5 GB or 10K items.

claims.claim: Vague or contradictory requests can produce an invalid result explaining why the request could not be interpreted.
claims.quote: Sometimes a request is too vague, contradictory, or asks for something the search service doesn't support. In those cases, you see an invalid result with a reason explaining why the request couldn't be interpreted.

claims.claim: SCU consumption can also be tracked in Security Copilot's usage monitoring tool.
claims.quote: You can track your SCU consumption in the usage monitoring tool.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 inclusion provides 400 SCUs per month per 1,000 paid user licences.
claims.quote: Customers with Microsoft 365 E5 and E7 will have 400 Security Compute Units (SCU) each month for every 1,000 paid user license, up to 10,000 SCUs each month at no additional cost.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: Included SCU capacity covers all Purview agentic scenarios, including this Security Copilot agent.
claims.quote: Core Experiences: All chat, promptbook, and agentic scenarios across Microsoft Entra, Microsoft Intune, Microsoft Purview, Microsoft Defender, and the standalone Security Copilot portal.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: Included SCU allocations reset monthly.
claims.quote: SCU allocations reset monthly and don't roll over if unused. Customers can't carry forward unused SCUs to future months.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: The inclusion page describes throttling beyond the allocation at a future date.
claims.quote: Usage beyond the allocated SCUs will be throttled at a future date. Customers have an option to scale beyond the allocated amount at $6 USD for each SCU on a pay-as-you go basis at that time.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: For provisioned capacity, overage limits can be unlimited or set to a maximum.
claims.quote: You can set limits for overage units as unlimited or set a maximum upper amount.

claims.where: Cost and licensing: Included capacity and limits
claims.claim: Once provisioned and overage SCUs are exhausted, analysts see an error and cannot submit more prompts at that time.
claims.quote: When the provisioned and overage SCUs is crossed, the analyst will see an error message ... Analysts can't submit more prompts at this time. More capacity would become available in the next hour.

claims.claim: The tenant must be onboarded to Security Copilot.
claims.quote: Your tenant must be onboarded to Microsoft Security Copilot. ... You must enable the Microsoft Purview plug-in in Microsoft Security Copilot.

claims.claim: Auditing must be on to see the latest status of labels applied to files.
claims.quote: To view the latest status for labels applied to files, make sure auditing is turned on

claims.claim: Deployment follows Agents > Explore agents > agent > Add > Setup > Deploy agent > Create and use agent identity (recommended) or Assign and use my identity.
claims.quote: select Agents. Select Explore agents. Select the agent to enable, and then select Add. ... Select Setup, this action opens the Deploy agent global configuration page. ... Choose Create and use agent identity (recommended) or Assign and use my identity.

claims.claim: Restricted searches targeting named users, groups or sites are more efficient than tenant-wide searches.
claims.quote: enter at least 3 characters to search for users, groups, or sites. ... For more efficient and faster processing, use a restricted search rather than tenant-wide searches.

claims.claim: Every control the governance checklist asks readers to check or configure appears in the controls table.
claims.quote: Checklist: 'Check SCU capacity'; 'Deploy ... record which identity option was chosen'; 'Start with prompts restricted'; 'Hold off scheduling prompts'. Table: agent deactivation, consumption monitoring, audit search.
claims.fix: The Before rollout capacity check and the At rollout deployment/identity, prompt-scope and scheduling steps have no corresponding controls-table rows. Remove those checklist steps or recast them as planning advice outside the checklist; do not add control rows in this correction.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API, PowerShell cmdlet or CLI command for deploying this agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent API PowerShell deploy deactivate remove SCU usage; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Posture Agent deploy deactivate remove; Security Copilot agents API deactivate deployment Purview. Read get-started and agents-manage; no deployment call found.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents no API, PowerShell cmdlet or CLI command for removing this agent.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Posture Agent API PowerShell deploy deactivate remove SCU usage; site:learn.microsoft.com/powershell Posture Agent deploy deactivate remove. Read get-started Remove agent and agents-manage; no agent-removal call found.

claims.claim: After removal, the agent can be used again by repeating its enabling steps.
claims.quote: Removing the agent deletes it from Microsoft Purview. To use it again, follow Enabling the agent.

claims.claim: SCU capacity is managed in Security Copilot rather than in the agent's settings.
claims.quote: You can update provisioned security compute units and overage units in the Azure portal and the Security Copilot portal.

claims.claim: Running the agent, viewing snippets and matched files, and labelling files are governed by Purview roles rather than a documented agent permission setting.
claims.quote: Permissions for running and viewing results from the Posture Agent ... Role Name | Can run Posture Agent and view summary | Can view content snippet that matched intent | Can view file matched intent | Can label file
